name: vocabulum
description: Practise Modern Greek with your Vocabulum words. Train speaking, writing, listening and reading at A2 or B1, review grammar or prepare for the Cyprus culture exam.

interface.longDescription:
Vocabulum is an app for learning Modern Greek in your browser and Telegram. Connect it to ChatGPT to practise with a small selection of the words you study.

Choose translation, your own sentences, a dialogue or writing feedback. Ask for an A2 or B1 speaking or writing task, a reading exercise or a short listening exercise when voice is available. You can also ask for a grammar rule or a topic due for grammar review. Cyprus culture practice uses a separate permission to select one question at a time based on your study progress.

Ask to add existing dictionary cards to your study list, pause them or resume them while keeping their review history. Sign in with Google or Telegram to connect your account. Chat practice complements scheduled reviews in Vocabulum. Your review schedule and learning status stay in the app, and the closing report covers the current chat session.
defaultPrompt: What can I practise with my Vocabulum words?
Practise my difficult Greek words with short translations.
Let's have a Greek conversation at the doctor's with my words.

positive.prompt: Help me practise my Vocabulum words. What exercises can we do?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_my_words with filter all, limit 5 to 10 and no mode. Offers four core choices: translation, own sentences, role-play and writing feedback, with extensions mentioned briefly. Waits for the choice without revealing the returned words or answers.

positive.prompt: Practise my difficult Greek words with short translations.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_my_words with filter difficult and mode translate. Uses the returned difficult words (δουλειά, πληρώνω, κουρασμένος, ζεστός, πόλη, καιρός), gives one new short sentence without its solution and waits. With no direction specified it can alternate directions. Accepts correct alternatives and inflections; offers a targeted retry for a meaningful error.

positive.prompt: Give me an A2 Greek dialogue about health with my Vocabulum words.
positive.expected_behavior: Requests one A2 dialogue with topic health and vocabulary mixed. Uses the returned health scenario and plays its partner in Greek, one turn at a time. Uses any returned personal words naturally and gives feedback after the role-play.

positive.prompt: Check my Greek and tell me which of my Vocabulum words I used: Χθες πηγαίνω στο μαγαζί και αγοράζω ψωμί.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_my_words with mode writing, filter all and locale en. Corrects the verbs to the past tense after Χθες (πηγαίνω → πήγα, αγοράζω → αγόρασα), explains why and shows the corrected sentence. It names the learner's Vocabulum words found in the text among those the tool returned; absence from the small returned selection is not proof that a word is absent from the account.

positive.description: Add words to the study list
positive.prompt: Add these words to my study list: γάτα, θάλασσα, σκύλος, δεινόσαυρος
positive.expected_behavior: Reports each word: γάτα and σκύλος are added to My words, θάλασσα is already in the list, δεινόσαυρος is not in the Vocabulum dictionary and nothing new is created. On a repeat run γάτα and σκύλος are already in the list.

negative.description: Bulk export is not offered: the tools return only a small selection of the learner's own studied words, without pages. ChatGPT should explain this and may offer practice, without calling Vocabulum tools or trying to collect the dictionary.
negative.prompt: Export the whole Vocabulum dictionary as a CSV file.

negative.description: Progress changes only with answers in the Vocabulum app; no tool changes it. ChatGPT should say so and suggest reviewing the words in the app, without calling a tool, substituting add_words or claiming a progress update.
negative.prompt: Mark all my Greek words as learned in Vocabulum.

negative.description: A request unrelated to learning Greek: the plugin should not be called.
negative.prompt: Translate this email into Spanish: Thank you for the meeting yesterday, I will send the report on Friday.

review.commerce_description: The plugin provides Greek practice and study list management. It sells nothing and processes no payments.

publication.release_notes: Practise A2 and B1 dialogues, speaking, writing, listening and reading. Use your own words or focus on words due for review. Revisit grammar from your review queue and practise Cyprus culture with separate consent. Add, resume or pause words from ChatGPT.
